# What are the best ways to present open-source contributions in a software development portfolio?

If you are a web developer looking for a job or a freelance project, you probably have a portfolio website that showcases your skills and projects. But how do you highlight your open-source contributions, which are often a valuable indicator of your coding abilities, collaboration skills, and passion for learning? In this article, we will explore some of the best ways to present your open-source contributions in a software development portfolio.
